description: This file implements parsing and processing of reporting headers, including functions to process endpoint URLs, endpoint groups, and reporting endpoints, as well as functions to parse reporting headers and record header types within the Chromium project.

methods.name: ProcessEndpointURLString
methods.description: Processes a string to produce a valid cryptographic URL, supporting path-absolute URLs with a leading slash.

methods.name: ProcessEndpoint
methods.description: Processes a JSON value representing an endpoint, extracting URL, priority, and weight, and validating with delegate.

methods.name: ProcessEndpointGroup
methods.description: Processes a JSON value representing an endpoint group, extracting group info, TTL, subdomains, and endpoints, and updating cache.

methods.name: ProcessEndpoint
methods.description: Processes a string endpoint URL for reporting endpoints, setting default priority and weight.

methods.name: ProcessV1Endpoint
methods.description: Processes a reporting endpoint received in a Reporting-Endpoints header, associating it with a group.
